_note: The Capy Cove live-ops calendar. Edit it and save: the server hot-reloads within a second and NEVER goes down for a broken edit (it keeps serving the last good calendar and shouts in the log). All times are America/New_York, always, on purpose. Effect verbs: coins {mult>=1, reasons|games}, decorate {room: theme}, spotlight <game>, doubleStamps, flag {name: value}, notice {headline, body}, sky {aurora, weather}, shop {featured, discount}, mural {cooldownMs}, bots {route, share}, quest {extra}, goal {id}. A coins mult below 1.0 is REFUSED at load: nothing here may ever make a payout smaller.

events.name: Friday Fete
events.blurb: Bunting in the plaza and every game pays one and a half until nine.

notice.headline: Friday Fete, 8pm ET.
notice.body: The plaza puts the bunting up and every game pays one and a half for an hour. Nothing to sign up for: just play.

announce.startMsg: Friday Fete! The bunting is up and every game pays one and a half for an hour.
announce.endMsg: The Fete is over and the bunting stays up till morning. Nicely played, everyone.

events.name: Sunday Splash
events.blurb: An afternoon in the water: buoys on the Drift, flags on the beach, and the fishing rods are out.

notice.headline: Sunday Splash, 3pm ET.
notice.body: Two hours on the water. Big Blue surfaces more often, the beach flies its flags, and Reel Rush is in the spotlight.

announce.startMsg: Sunday Splash! Buoys on the Drift, flags on the beach, and Big Blue is about.
